issue.title: Successor Offer glossary strand repeats its own title block
issue.description: The glossary:successor-offer strand body begins with a stray '# Successor Offer' heading followed by '*Requested · project*' — it looks like pasted 'sase memory read' output. Evidence: (1) 'sase memory read glossary:successor-offer' prints the title and the '*Requested · project*' line twice; (2) the generated docs/reference/glossary.md shows '### Successor Offer {#successor-offer}' followed by a level-one '# Successor Offer' and an italic '*Requested · project*' line (around L208–212), so the public glossary page has an extra H1 in the middle. Fix: use /sase_memory_write to delete the two stray lines from the strand body so it starts at 'aka offer, pull-in offer', then republish (sase memory init) and regenerate the docs glossary.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Delete the stray '# Successor Offer' heading and '*Requested · project*' line at the top of the strand body so the body starts with 'aka offer, pull-in offer'; then republish memory and regenerate docs/reference/glossary.md.

issue.creation_reason: Found while reading glossary strands for rotten-log research: the strand body carries a stray title block that renders as a second H1 inside the published glossary.
